description: Shared tasks for people and agents: add, take, check off

collections.tasks: one doc per task: { title, done (bool), claimedBy (email of whoever is on it, or null), note (one line on what was done, or null), doneAt (ms, or null) }

functions.claim: Claims the oldest open task nobody has taken, for the caller. input: none; returns { task: { id, title } }, or { task: null } when none is left. Safe when several agents call at once.

tidy.description: Deletes tasks done more than 7 days ago. input: none; returns { deleted }
